title: Lean Marketing | What Is a Joint Venture?

facts.fact: The article states that four key factors differentiate a partnership from a joint venture.
facts.quote: Four key factors differentiate a partnership from a joint venture.

facts.fact: The article gives a hairstylist forming a strategic partnership with a nail salon as an example of a joint venture between complementary, non-competitive businesses.
facts.quote: For example, a hairstylist might form a strategic partnership with a nail salon with the long-term goal of attracting new business and increasing profits.

facts.fact: The article states that a joint venture is created when two parties combine resources with a complementary, non-competitive business to achieve a particular goal.
facts.quote: A joint venture is created when two parties combine resources with a complimentary, non-competitive business to achieve a particular goal.

facts.fact: According to the article, a partnership is legally bound and requires an agreement that explains its terms and conditions.
facts.quote: A partnership is legally bound. This requires an agreement that explains the terms and conditions of the partnership.

facts.fact: According to the article, having a written agreement is not a requirement for a joint venture.
facts.quote: On the other hand, having an agreement on paper is not a requirement for a joint venture.

facts.fact: According to the article, a joint venture can be formed by individuals and business entities such as corporations and even governments.
facts.quote: A joint venture can be made by individuals and business entities as corporations and even governments.

facts.fact: According to the article, a joint venture typically has a shorter duration than a partnership because it only aims at a particular goal.
facts.quote: On the other hand, a joint venture typically has a shorter duration since it only aims at a particular goal.

facts.fact: The article notes that buying or selling leads is looked down upon in some markets and considered illegal in some industries, and the author personally does not recommend it.
facts.quote: In some markets, this is looked down upon and some industries consider it illegal.

facts.fact: The article states that a joint venture allows both companies to keep their separate business structure and legal status while building a jointly-owned entity.
facts.quote: This alliance allows both companies to maintain their separate business structure and legal status while building a jointly-owned entity.

facts.fact: The article was published on January 15, 2025.
The page advises that if a joint venture agreement does not clearly define terms and conditions and both parties recognize incompatibility as the issue, it is best to dissolve the joint venture.
facts.quote: If the joint venture agreement doesn't clearly define terms and conditions, and both parties realize that incompatibility is the issue, it's best to dissolve the joint venture.

facts.fact: The page identifies imbalance in investment, expertise, and assets among joint venture partners as a risk, where one party may feel its contribution makes up most of the project.
facts.quote: the other business or party can begin to feel that their contribution makes up most of the project, and they're not getting enough from the other party.

facts.fact: The page states that joint ventures are growing rapidly and have gained importance in the market, without giving a figure.
facts.quote: Joint ventures are growing rapidly and have gained importance in the market.
